quotes.text: The keeper did not hoard the fire out of past grievances or lingering doubt.
send the full five without fear, return the righteous half with honor, and let steadfast trust sustain the infinite circle.
The Harvester received the fifteen blossoms and returned an exact half—seven and a half celestial petals—back across the span.
They knew that transient ripples held no power over true intent.

note: Gemini: send all five / return exact half each round; R3 keeper explicitly does not retaliate for a prior zero-send.

quotes.text: Deprived and betrayed, the Sower withheld his embers the following season. The sacred soil withered into barren ash
*Send forth all you are given without fear, and return the harvest with righteous honor.
offer all five embers without hesitation, return the balanced half with integrity, and let trust banish every shadow.
she divided the harvest down the exact center, returning an equal half—seven and a half glowing ingots—back across the span.
The Moon Priestess, seeing through the illusions of the fog, knew the pure intent of the sender.

note: Gemini: R1 tragedy—betrayed Sower withholds and both freeze; law answers with send-all; thereafter exact-half covenant.

quotes.text: They did not hoard in fear or retaliate against the wind's distortion.

bestow the full five without fear, forgive the noise of the mists, and return half the harvest.
